name: Giselle
source:
Rufina's younger sister. Prideful and capricious. She feels inferior to her sister.
She looks down on humans and is soon summoned to the human world, but she kills her summoner and goes on a rampage.

Translated from https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/announce/=/product_id/RJ01050320.html
